name: GhostDialog
description: Headless dialog root provider. Manages controlled/uncontrolled open state via useControllableState, modal mode (trapped focus, scroll lock, inert background siblings, overlay), and deterministic trigger/content/title/description IDs.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is omitted.

props.name: modal
props.description: Enables modal behavior (trapped focus, scroll lock, inert background, overlay).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Trigger, overlay, content, title, description, close parts, and optional custom UI reading the scoped state.

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state across trigger, overlay, and content while the dialog is open.

states.name: closed
states.description: Applied on GhostDialogTrigger data-state while the dialog is closed.

keyboard.Enter: Opens or toggles the dialog on GhostDialogTrigger or closes on GhostDialogClose.
keyboard.Space: Opens or toggles the dialog on GhostDialogTrigger or closes on GhostDialogClose.
keyboard.Tab: Moves focus forward through tabbable descendants, wrapping within modal dialogs.
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Moves focus backward through tabbable descendants, wrapping within modal dialogs.
keyboard.Escape: Dismisses the topmost open dialog when closeOnEscape is enabled and restores focus.
